rights.why: Europe PMC reports isOpenAccess N and no licence for this record; the PMC deposit is free to read after the publisher's delay, which is access, not a redistribution right. These crops reproduce printed sentences from the article, so the images are gitignored and are not published with this repository. This file is the recipe that regenerates them byte-identically from a copy of the PDF the reader already holds - publish the derivation, not the derived.

why_this_article_is_adjudicated: 🔴 THE TEXT LAYER OF THIS PDF IS SUSPECT AND STAYS SUSPECT. Across 30,273 extracted characters it carries 191 C0 control characters (7 U+0001, 37 U+0002, 79 U+0003, 3 U+0004, 21 U+0005, 15 U+0006, 25 U+0007, 4 U+0008) and ZERO occurrences of < > <= >= +/- x - micro mu alpha beta gamma, in a paper that prints 'P < 0.05' in its Statistical Analysis section, 'beta-actin' in its antisera list, '25 microg loaded' in a figure legend and '5 x 10^6 viable cells' in its animal methods. deepdive_manifest.py's _refuse_suspect_surface REFUSES it on the C0 check. No structured surface exists: Europe PMC fullTextXML returns 404, NCBI efetch db=pmc returns metadata with the explicit note 'The publisher of this article does not allow downloading of the full text in XML form', the PMC article HTML returns a reCAPTCHA interstitial and the Europe PMC HTML is JavaScript-rendered. Every text proposition this reading carries is therefore anchored to the DRAWN GLYPH.
needles: Each artifact names the locator it adjudicates and the needle that must fall inside the crop. The crop is built over the whole sentence so the drawn glyphs can be read in context; the NEEDLE is a single-line fragment of that sentence chosen because search_for returns exactly one span for it. That distinction is deliberate: regenerate_adjudications.py requires a needle to resolve uniquely, and a needle that wraps across a column break returns one rectangle per line and is refused as non-unique.
